podcast.body: Released in 1981, this album featured the hit song "Hold On Loosely," which reached number three on the charts. The album's success was partly attributed to the band's shift in sound, with songs written by Don Barnes specifically designed for radio play and MTV. The recording of "Hold On Loosely" started in 1979 and was completed for this 1981 release. "Then came Wildeide Southern boys in 1981 and hold on loosely made it to number three."
